desc: Derive and implement the X-coordinate square-root decomposition with persistent B-prefix count/sum queries.
Formulate the persistent segment-tree query returning \(\sum_{j\le y}|a-B_j|\), including coordinate compression and count/sum aggregation.
Select a practical block size and prove the resulting time and memory complexity fits Python constraints.
Implement final stdin/stdout Python solution and verify it on the provided samples.
